Compact session header · round 2 · top bar

Claude Design, 27 Nov 2026. The window top bar after the 32 pt custom bar was built: what height is right on every Mac, and what the bar does in full screen when the traffic lights come and go. Rules: rules.md § Round 2.

Pick Q1: N · back to the native NSToolbar .unifiedCompact (AppKit sets the height, 40 pt here, and the inset after the lights). M · keep the custom bar, but measure height and inset at run time. Never a fixed 28 or 69.

Pick Q2: ride along · no fixed gap; the left items slide right while the lights show and back when they hide, on the menu bar's own clock. No notch: the bar rides down under the menu bar. Notch: the bar stays under the black band.

Q2 · reveal motion spec

One clock, the menu bar's; N vs M column; 0.25 s ease-in-out only as the fallback; Reduce Motion: no slide.

r2 · Q2 · the reveal, frame by frame

One clock: the menu bar's. Four things follow it, nothing else moves

whatN · native toolbar (pick)M · custom bar (if you keep it)
clockAppKit's; we add no animation of our ownfollow the full-screen titlebar's frame every frame: p = shown height ÷ menu bar height; no own timer, so it can't drift from the menu bar
fallback timing—only if there is no frame to follow: 0.25 s (NSAnimationContext default), ease-in-out, started by the reveal, same curve back on hide
left insetAppKit lays the first item after the lightslerp(12, lights' maxX + 12, p); the lights' maxX measured, never 69
bar while menu showsrides down with the menu bar (no notch), stays under the band (notch)same; overlays the top of the content with a shadow, content never reflows
right-side pillsnever move
Reduce Motionno slide: positions jump with the system's cross-fade
enter / leave full screeninset snaps to the windowed value as the transition ends; no extra animation on top of the system's
